KLAC.basis: Grade reduced for a 39.5x trailing EV/EBITDA premium and wafer-fab-equipment cyclicality despite 61.3% GAAP gross margin and strong free cash flow.

ANET.basis: Debt-free balance sheet, 37.7% growth and 45.4% GAAP operating margin support quality, but 51.1x trailing EV/EBITDA constrains the grade below A-range.

MRVL.basis: Data-center growth and Q3 guidance are strong, but approximately 73.4x trailing EV/EBITDA, customer concentration and custom-ASIC execution cap fundamental quality at B.

VICR.basis: Net cash and 58.0% quarterly GAAP gross margin are offset by customer concentration, royalty volatility and approximately 76.0x rebuilt trailing EV/EBITDA on both common classes.

AVGO.basis: AI growth and cash conversion remain exceptional, but approximately 43.4x trailing EV/EBITDA, $64.91B debt, VMware integration and hyperscaler concentration require a B cap.

AMD.basis: Data Center growth supports quality, but approximately 79.9x trailing EV/EBITDA, accelerator execution, export controls and foundry dependence make the former A grade indefensible.

MU.basis: Record HBM margins and free cash flow are real, but 11.5x trailing EV/revenue and memory-cycle mean reversion require a full-cycle B grade rather than A.
